answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network mandates cryptographic stake burning where registering the n-th replica incurs a superlinear cost scaling as O(n^2). Each transaction acts like a whisper across an open meadow, requiring an irrecoverable burn of scarce tokens. Locking a permanent deposit of rare jade ensures malicious clone swarms face exponential economic friction, making large-scale coordination mathematically unprofitable.
